instruction: How to use conntrack in nftables firewall
output: nft add rule inet filter input ct state established,related accept

instruction: How to drop invalid conntrack state in nftables
output: nft add rule inet filter input ct state invalid drop

instruction: How to allow new SSH in nftables using conntrack
output: nft add rule inet filter input tcp dport 22 ct state new accept

instruction: How to set notrack in nftables
output: nft add rule inet raw prerouting tcp dport 80 notrack

instruction: How to add ct helper in nftables
output: nft add rule inet filter forward tcp dport 21 ct helper set ftp

instruction: How to set conntrack zone in nftables
output: nft add rule inet filter forward tcp dport 80 ct zone set 1

instruction: How to set conntrack timeout in nftables
output: nft add rule inet filter forward tcp dport 80 ct timeout set my-timeout

instruction: How to mark conntrack in nftables
output: nft add rule inet filter forward ct mark set packet mark

instruction: How to restore conntrack mark to packet in nftables
output: nft add rule inet filter forward meta mark set ct mark

instruction: How to delete conntrack from nftables set
output: conntrack -D -p tcp -s 10.0.0.1 --dport 80

instruction: How to add a ct expectation in nftables
output: conntrack -I expect -p udp --orig-src 10.0.0.1 --orig-dst 10.0.0.2 --orig-port-src 5060 --orig-port-dst 5060

instruction: How to delete a ct expectation in nftables
output: conntrack -D expect -p udp --orig-src 10.0.0.1

instruction: How to list all ct expectations
output: conntrack -L expect

instruction: How to flush all ct expectations
output: conntrack -F expect

instruction: How to update conntrack timeout in nftables
output: nft add timeout my-timeout inet tcp established 60000

instruction: How to show conntrack drops in netstat
output: netstat -s | grep conntrack

instruction: How to check conntrack error counters
output: nft list counters | grep conntrack

instruction: How to enable conntrack accounting in sysctl
output: sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_acct=1

instruction: How to log conntrack decisions
output: iptables -A INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate NEW -j LOG --log-prefix 'NEW_CONN: '

instruction: How to log conntrack drops
output: iptables -A INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate INVALID -j LOG --log-prefix 'DROP_INVALID: '

instruction: How to use conntrack with NFQUEUE
output: iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 80 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW -j NFQUEUE --queue-num 1

instruction: How to enable conntrack SYNPROXY
output: iptables -t raw -A PREROUTING -p tcp --dport 80 -j CT --notrack && iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 80 -m conntrack --ctstate INVALID -j SYNPROXY --sack-perm --timestamp --wscale 7 --mss 1460

instruction: How to disable conntrack for localhost
output: iptables -t raw -A OUTPUT -o lo -j NOTRACK && iptables -t raw -A PREROUTING -i lo -j NOTRACK

instruction: How to save conntrack entries to file
output: conntrack -L -o xml > conntrack-backup.xml

instruction: How to restore conntrack entries from dump
output: cat conntrack-backup.xml | conntrack -I -o xml
